doc.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015

title: Jazz education versus learning from uncles
summary: Bucky says he learned more from his uncles and Paterson musicians than kids get at music school today.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: I see. Wow. You know you’ve done a lot of interviews. In fact this is our third one. Is there ever a question that nobody asks that you’d like to talk about.
What’s your take on jazz education?
That’s a good question. I mean the kids all go to music school today, and what they got out of it, I got more out of not going to school for music. There’s a way of doing it.
I had my uncles show me, and I knew the good musicians in Paterson, and I learned from them more than anybody else.
Do you think that can still happen these days?
